name: Summon Fey
description: Summons one fey creature whose Hit Dice are no greater than the level of the spell. The spell is scalable, so casting it from a higher-level slot raises that Hit Die cap to the slot's level. Material component: a pat of butter.
note: Printed class line is Drd/Sha 1 (druid or shaman). Kingdoms of Kalamar is a 3.0-era book, so its stat-block conventions differ from 3.5.
